author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at allegations of Google attacking the remaining bastions of privacy on our mobile devices by needlessly targeting the largest privacy OS on their devices, GrapheneOS. I've spoken about this in the past but Google has escalated their actions and at this point they need to be reined in. Thanks for watching!

title: Google Has Become More Evil Than Ever...
